outputs.L1: The invention relates to a method for configuring a mobile user device as a remote controller for a hearing aid. The mobile user device comprises a removable Secure Digital (SD) card, which includes a radio interface and an antenna controller for configuring the radio interface for wireless communication with the hearing aid, and a computer-readable memory for storing a software application for remotely controlling the hearing aid via the communication module. The method comprises: requesting a communication module identifier from the communication module; sending, to a server, a request for hearing-aid setting information associated with the hearing aid, the request comprising the communication module identifier; receiving at least part of the hearing-aid setting information if the server determines, on the basis of the communication module identifier, that access to the hearing-aid setting information by the mobile user device is allowed; and configuring the radio interface of the communication module on the basis of the hearing-aid setting information.
outputs.L2: The invention concerns a process for setting up a mobile user device to function as a remote control for a hearing aid. The mobile user device includes a removable secure digital (SD) card that contains a radio interface and an antenna controller arranged to set up the radio interface for wireless communication with the hearing aid. The device also includes computer-readable memory storing a software application that enables remote control of the hearing aid through the communication module. The process includes obtaining a communication module identifier from the communication module; transmitting to a server a request for hearing-aid configuration information linked to the hearing aid, the request including the communication module identifier; receiving all or a portion of the hearing-aid configuration information when the server determines, using the communication module identifier, that the mobile user device is permitted to access that information; and configuring the radio interface of the communication module according to the received hearing-aid configuration information.
outputs.L3:
The invention relates to a method for configuring a mobile user device so that it can operate as a remote controller for a hearing aid. In particular, the method enables a conventional mobile device, such as a mobile phone, smartphone, or handheld computing device, to communicate with and control one or more functions of a hearing aid by using a removable communication module.

The mobile user device is provided with a removable SD card that includes components required for wireless communication with the hearing aid. The SD card comprises a radio interface for transmitting and receiving wireless signals, an antenna controller for controlling operation of an antenna associated with the radio interface, and a memory in which a hearing aid control application is stored. When the SD card is inserted into the mobile user device, the hearing aid control application may be executed by the mobile user device to provide a user interface for controlling hearing aid functions, such as volume, program selection, sound processing settings, or other configurable parameters.

As part of the configuration process, the mobile user device requests a communication module identifier from the communication module. The communication module identifier may uniquely identify the removable SD card or the radio communication module included in the SD card. This identifier can be used to determine whether the communication module is authorized to access hearing aid configuration data or to communicate with a particular hearing aid.

After obtaining the communication module identifier, the mobile user device sends a request to a server for hearing aid setting information associated with the hearing aid. The request includes the communication module identifier and may also include additional information, such as an identifier of the hearing aid, a user account identifier, or information relating to the mobile user device. The server uses the communication module identifier to determine whether access to the requested hearing aid setting information should be granted.

If the server authorizes access based on the communication module identifier, it transmits the relevant hearing aid setting information to the mobile user device. The hearing aid setting information may include communication parameters, pairing data, frequency settings, protocol information, encryption keys, or other configuration data needed to enable reliable communication between the mobile user device and the hearing aid.

The mobile user device then configures the radio interface of the removable SD card according to the received hearing aid setting information. Once configured, the radio interface can communicate with the hearing aid, allowing the mobile user device to function as a remote controller. In this way, the invention provides a secure and flexible mechanism for enabling hearing aid control functionality on a mobile user device by using a removable SD card-based communication module and server-authorized configuration data.
outputs.L4:
The invention relates to a method and system for configuring a mobile user device so that it can operate as a wireless remote controller for a hearing aid. The mobile user device may be, for example, a mobile telephone, smartphone, PDA, tablet, or another portable electronic device capable of receiving a removable communication module. The communication module is preferably provided in the form of an SD-card or similar removable card and includes a radio interface suitable for communicating with the hearing aid.

According to the method, the communication module is first inserted into or connected with the mobile user device. The mobile user device then detects the presence of the module and initiates a configuration procedure. During this procedure, the mobile user device requests or reads a module identifier from the removable communication module. The module identifier may be a unique serial number, hardware identifier, cryptographic identifier, or another code that uniquely identifies the communication module.

The mobile user device transmits the module identifier to a remote server. The server checks whether the identified communication module is authorized to receive configuration information for a particular hearing aid or group of hearing aids. This authorization may be based on registration data, user account information, hearing-aid ownership information, pairing data, service-provider records, or other access-control information stored at the server.

If the server determines that the communication module and/or the user device is authorized, the server provides hearing-aid setting information to the mobile user device. The hearing-aid setting information may include radio communication parameters, pairing data, encryption keys, access credentials, hearing-aid identifiers, channel information, frequency information, protocol information, or control parameters required for communication between the SD-card communication module and the hearing aid. The server may also provide application data or configuration instructions that allow software on the mobile user device to present a user interface for controlling the hearing aid.

After receiving the authorized hearing-aid setting information, the mobile user device configures the removable communication module accordingly. In particular, the radio interface of the communication module is set up so that it can establish a secure wireless connection with the hearing aid. Once configured, the mobile user device can be used as a remote controller for the hearing aid. Through the mobile user device, the user may adjust functions such as volume, listening program, microphone directionality, noise reduction mode, balance, or other hearing-aid operating parameters.

A significant aspect of the invention is that the hearing-aid setting information is not freely available to any device. Instead, access to such information is controlled by the server and is granted only after verification of the module identifier and any associated authorization data. As a result, unauthorized mobile devices or unauthorized communication modules cannot obtain the information required to communicate with or control the hearing aid.

This provides improved security and reliability for wireless hearing-aid control. The hearing aid is protected against unauthorized access, accidental interference, or manipulation by unapproved devices. At the same time, the system allows a standard mobile user device to be conveniently converted into a hearing-aid remote controller simply by using an authorized removable SD-card communication module and obtaining the appropriate configuration data from the server.

**The Power of “The”**

“The” may be one of the smallest words in the English language, but it is also one of the most important. As a definite article, “the” helps us point to something specific. For example, when we say “a book,” we could mean any book. But when we say “the book,” we mean a particular book that the speaker and listener already know about.

This simple word gives clarity and direction to communication. It helps identify people, places, objects, and ideas. We use it in everyday phrases like “the sun,” “the world,” “the future,” and “the truth.” Without “the,” many sentences would feel incomplete or unclear.

Although it is short, “the” plays a powerful role in language. It connects meaning, creates focus, and helps us understand exactly what is being discussed. In many ways, “the” proves that even the smallest words can have the greatest importance.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for an invention where a mobile phone uses a removable SD card with a radio interface to act as a remote controller for a hearing aid, including server authorization based on a communication module identifier.
counterfactuals.output: A mobile communication device is configured to operate as a remote controller for a hearing aid by receiving a removable memory card having an integrated radio communication interface. The removable memory card, such as an SD card, includes a communication module adapted to transmit control signals to the hearing aid over a short-range wireless link. A control application executed by the mobile communication device generates hearing-aid adjustment commands, including volume, program selection, or fitting parameters, and communicates the commands to the removable memory card for wireless transmission to the hearing aid. Access to the remote-control functionality is authorized by a server, which receives an identifier associated with the communication module of the removable memory card and determines whether the communication module is permitted for use with the hearing aid and/or the control application. Upon authorization, the server enables the mobile communication device to control the hearing aid via the removable memory card, thereby providing hearing-aid remote-control functionality without requiring a dedicated external controller.

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate an invention summary in the style of a European patent application for remotely controlling a hearing aid via a mobile device equipped with an SD card communication module and server-provided configuration data.
counterfactuals.output:
**Invention Summary**

The present invention relates to the field of hearing aid systems and, in particular, to a system and method for remotely controlling and/or configuring a hearing aid by means of a mobile communication device. The invention further relates to a mobile device equipped with a removable communication module, preferably in the form of an SD card, mini-SD card or micro-SD card, configured to establish a wireless communication link with the hearing aid, and to a server-based infrastructure for providing hearing-aid-specific configuration data to the mobile device.

Conventional hearing aids typically require adjustment by a hearing care professional using dedicated programming equipment. This may be inconvenient for the user, in particular when minor parameter changes are required in everyday situations. Although some hearing aids support wireless control, such systems often require a dedicated remote control unit or are limited to predefined user commands. There is therefore a need for an improved solution enabling a user to control or adjust a hearing aid using a commonly available mobile device, while allowing configuration data to be centrally managed and securely provided.

According to the invention, a mobile device, such as a mobile telephone, smartphone, personal digital assistant or portable computer, is provided with an SD card communication module. The SD card communication module comprises a card interface for connection to an SD card slot of the mobile device and a wireless communication interface for communicating with a hearing aid. The wireless communication interface may comprise, for example, an inductive near-field interface, a radio-frequency interface, a Bluetooth interface, a low-energy wireless interface, or another short-range communication interface adapted to the communication capabilities of the hearing aid.

The mobile device is configured to execute a control application. The control application receives configuration data associated with a particular hearing aid or hearing-aid user from a remote server via a mobile communication network, wireless local area network or other data connection. The configuration data may include hearing aid identification data, communication parameters, user interface definitions, permissible adjustment ranges, fitting parameters, program settings, gain or frequency response settings, noise reduction parameters, directional microphone settings, feedback cancellation settings, or authorization information. Based on the received configuration data, the mobile device generates control commands for the hearing aid and transmits the control commands via the SD card communication module.

In one embodiment, the server stores a user profile and/or a hearing aid profile. The mobile device transmits identification information to the server, such as a user identifier, hearing aid serial number, SD card module identifier or application identifier. In response, the server provides configuration data adapted to the identified hearing aid and/or the user’s audiological profile. This enables the mobile device to present a user interface specifically adapted to the connected hearing aid without requiring the control application to be pre-installed with all possible hearing aid data.

In a further embodiment, the server-provided configuration data defines which hearing aid functions are accessible to the user. For example, the user may be permitted to adjust volume, select listening programs, activate directional microphone modes, adjust noise suppression levels or select environment-specific sound profiles, while more sensitive fitting parameters remain locked or available only after authorization by a hearing care professional. The configuration data may therefore provide both functional customization and access control.

The SD card communication module may include a processor and memory for storing communication protocols, security data and temporary configuration information. Alternatively, at least part of the communication processing may be performed by the mobile device, with the SD card communication module acting as a physical communication interface. The SD card communication module may be powered via the SD card interface of the mobile device and may include an antenna or inductive coupling element for communication with the hearing aid.

The hearing aid may acknowledge receipt of control commands and may transmit status information back to the mobile device, such as battery status, active listening program, current volume level, error information or environmental classification data. The mobile device may forward such status information to the server, thereby allowing remote monitoring, logging or support by a hearing care professional.

The invention enables a hearing aid to be remotely controlled using a general-purpose mobile device while avoiding the need for a dedicated hearing aid remote control. By providing a communication module in the form of an SD card, the mobile device can be retrofitted with a wireless interface compatible with hearing aids even if the mobile device does not natively support such communication. Furthermore, server-provided configuration data allows the system to be adapted to different hearing aid types, users and authorization levels, thereby improving flexibility, maintainability and security.

In one aspect, the invention provides a method comprising: inserting or connecting an SD card communication module to a mobile device; establishing a data connection between the mobile device and a remote server; receiving, from the server, configuration data associated with a hearing aid; configuring a control application of the mobile device in accordance with the received configuration data; generating a hearing aid control command on the mobile device; and transmitting the control command from the mobile device to the hearing aid via the SD card communication module.

In another aspect, the invention provides a system comprising a hearing aid, a mobile device, an SD card communication module connected to the mobile device, and a server configured to provide configuration data to the mobile device. The mobile device is arranged to control the hearing aid via the SD card communication module using the configuration data received from the server.

By means of the invention, hearing aid control can be personalized, updated and extended remotely, while the physical communication capability required for interaction with the hearing aid is provided by a compact removable module. The system is therefore suitable for convenient user operation, remote service, and scalable deployment across different hearing aid platforms.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4
